title: Global Well-Posedness and Asymptotic Behavior of Energy-Damped Subquintic Wave Equations
summary: In this article, we consider a wave equation on a bounded three-dimensional domain, featuring a degenerate nonlocal damping mechanism that depends on the system's energy and a source term with subquintic growth. This class of models is motivated by applications in optical physics. We establish global existence in the Shatah--Strichartz sense by combining Galerkin approximations with space-time Strichartz estimates on bounded domains.
